source_summary: Cloudflare is positioning the Monetization Gateway as a way to charge for any Cloudflare-protected resource: web pages, datasets, APIs, and MCP tools. Chaser Agent should treat monetized web/API/MCP resources as governed research and execution surfaces, not as ambient URLs to fetch or tools to call. Therefore, Cloudflare Monetization Gateway should influence Chaser Agent as a **research-source and governance contract**, not as immediate payment integration.

source_metadata.title: Announcing the Monetization Gateway: charge for any resource behind Cloudflare via x402
source_metadata.authors: Rohin Lohe, Justin Ridgely, Will Papper
